name: visualizations: one missing for this dataset is not missing from the server
description: Written against an observed failure on usegalaxy.eu on 2026-10-13: asked whether Galaxy has a Cytoscape viewer while the history held only PDB files, the agent listed the visualizations for a PDB dataset and answered that Cytoscape was not installed. It was, for the cytoscapejson datatype. The datatype only comes from listing the server's visualizations without a dataset, so naming it shows the answer came from Galaxy.
inputs: In my history "cytoscape question $run", does this Galaxy have a Cytoscape visualization?
